connector.name: Xpay
connector.registryDescription: Agentic commerce for AI agents: multi-network wallet, x402 payments, AgenC hires, 20k+ services
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package xpay. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the xona-labs account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: XPAY_PROFILE
env.description: Wallet profile to load or create (default: active profile, else "default")

env.name: XPAY_PASSPHRASE
env.description: Encrypts the auto-generated wallet at rest; also unlocks an existing encrypted profile

env.name: XPAY_NO_AUTO_WALLET
env.description: Set to error instead of auto-generating a wallet when none is configured

env.name: XPAY_SOLANA_SECRET
env.description: Use an existing Solana secret key (base58) instead of the generated wallet

env.name: XPAY_EVM_KEY
env.description: Use an existing EVM private key instead of the generated wallet

env.name: XPAY_EVM_NETWORK
env.description: EVM network for XPAY_EVM_KEY (e.g. base, base-sepolia)
